status: accepted at assigned native/Lit and consumer-rendering boundaries
scope: Lit and React consumer-owned Table/Virtual examples

sources.read: complete page and upstream range helper
overview, installed 9.2.4 declarations and consumed feature/framework skills
complete adapter page and installed implementation
complete delivery-log-pagination.tsx and delivery-log-table.tsx from private reviewed collection
complete exports; no Table or Pagination export

implementation: Table retains one native author-owned table; RootStyles supplies scoped generated light-DOM CSS
Direct native scrolling and table refs; no rows/columns/data processor or virtualizer inside Table
Logical sticky hooks, density/size, selection/range decoration, native spans and isolated nested tables
Pagination composes shared actions, optional Position and Page Size parts; request-only state ownership
Known, unknown and zero totals, out-of-range application values, real URL mapping and localization
Applications own each Table, Virtual and experimental Worker instance; each framework retains its native cells
coverage: Cell selection and merge-aware ranges with keyboard editor boundaries
Native row/column spanning and covered-cell omission
Column ordering, pinning, resizing, sizing and visibility
Row expansion, pagination, pinning and selection
Vertical, horizontal and combined virtualization; dynamic measurements and offscreen focus
Actual experimental worker pending, failure, retry, manual server data and disposal
adaptations: Default Table typography, body padding, header height and stripe radii retain the prior generated baseline. Size increments follow the read Chakra recipe relative to those values.
Native semantic tags and CSS hooks replace custom row/cell wrappers. Data-index and measurements belong to the consumer.
The vertical virtual example uses unmerged measured rows; the horizontal example tests native merges with pinned/virtual columns. This does not claim every possible combination is certified.
corrections: Range outlines use inset shadows and do not change geometry
Nested tables reset private row/range presentation so outer selection cannot leak inward
Places distinguishes author assignment from rendered fallback; actual-browser control caught a gap in Happy DOM
Pagination does not retain inactive fallback parts when authored parts are present
Page-size Field composition uses content-sized horizontal layout rather than the settings-form label width
Virtual rows are measured only while their virtualizer is enabled; ResizeObserver work uses the public frame option
Horizontal virtual measurements are invalidated after column geometry changes

declarationPatch.reason: The experimental worker augmented private type modules while custom features augmented the public barrel. Two module targets now agree.

limits: The Table package versions and listed feature combinations are tested; future versions and untested combinations are not guaranteed.
Final generated React wrappers and actual Safari/assistive-technology acceptance remain M22/M26.

M25 will consolidate temporary browser runners into the durable CI harness; fixture sources and case bodies are retained here.
